description: quartz_monitor: fix spurious combo reactivation on continuous hold
root_cause: CGEventSourceKeyState lags behind Quartz tap callback — reports N as not-pressed during its own keydown, triggering spurious RELEASE+PRESS cycle on continuous hold
solution: Replaced CGEventSourceKeyState query with _release_pair_confirmed_locked() which requires confirmed Quartz KeyUp events for both Control and N before treating keydown as genuine fresh press

description: permissions: extend early-exit to OPEN_SETTINGS; skip silently when already granted
root_cause: OPEN_SETTINGS permissions had no early-exit probe — in partial-grant reinstall scenario step announcements and System Settings opened unnecessarily even when TCC already had the grant
solution: Added elif OPEN_SETTINGS early-exit block in _run_step_owner_path, not setting last_probe_at on non-skip to preserve TCC registration pre-probe. Updated 5 tests + added 1 new test with _FirstWaitingThenPassClassifier

description: permissions: skip first-run pipeline when all hard permissions already granted
root_cause: Fresh ledger on reinstall had UNKNOWN step states so is_first_run_complete() returned False — first-run pipeline and intro TTS activated even when all permissions already granted via macOS TCC
solution: Added preflight_all_hard_granted() to PermissionsV2Integration: probes all hard permissions live before any TTS or pipeline, marks ledger COMPLETED+restart_count=1 if all pass — is_first_run_complete() returns True and reemit fires instead of pipeline
